statement: A byte string using the reserved additional-info 28 in major type 7 is not decoded
deviation: RFC 8949 §3 Table 1 reserves ai 28/29/30 (unassigned). In major type 7, 20..=22 are false/true/null, 25..=27 are the float widths, 31 is break, and only 28-30 "carry no meaning" -- the scanner returns this as ReservedAdditionalInfo, **distinguished** from a plain SimpleValueNotAllowed. 29 (`fd`)/30 (`fe`) are neighboring values that pass through the same arm. The IPLD spec text carries no MUST here (excluded as req/33 §1's item 3), so the basis is gx's strict-by-default (CM-6).
origin: gx self-authored for the fix hand (req/38 §16 H6-4)

control.note: The nearest value that carries meaning in the same major type 7 = false (ai 20). This being accepted is what discriminates against "a scanner that refuses all of major 7"
